mapper.select: SELECT case_id AS caseId, status, score FROM game_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}
SELECT culprit_suspect_id AS culpritSuspectId, truth_summary AS truthSummary FROM case_solutions WHERE case_id = #{caseId}

SELECT skg.id AS keywordGroupId, sk.keyword_text AS keywordText FROM case_solutions cs INNER JOIN solution_keyword_groups skg ON skg.case_solution_id = cs.id INNER JOIN solution_keywords sk ON sk.keyword_group_id = skg.id WHERE cs.case_id = #{caseId} ORDER BY skg.display_order, sk.id
mapper.update: UPDATE game_sessions SET status = 'SOLVED', submitted_suspect_id = #{suspectId}, submitted_evidence_id = #{evidenceId}, submitted_truth = #{truth}, grade = #{grade}, solved_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'PLAYING'
UPDATE game_sessions SET score = GREATEST(score - 10, 0), wrong_answer_count = wrong_answer_count + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId}
